vlog_arc.theme: Protecting the afternoon — the part of the day nobody plans for

beats.mon: Leo opens on camera, unscripted, admitting his own 2pm fog hit hard today and he's filming through it, not around it.
beats.tue: He walks through his actual morning stack — training, coffee, kids out the door — and names the one hour that always breaks first.
beats.wed: A quiet behind-the-curtain moment packing orders, talking about why transparency matters more than a polished pitch.
beats.thu: Leo shares a real mistake from building Power Coffee this year and what he changed because of it.
beats.fri: He previews Saturday's Power Morning event, inviting people by name to come get a scoop stirred into their regular order.
beats.sat: Real, unedited footage from the Power Morning meetup — faces, the café, the line, a genuine thank-you to who showed up.
beats.sun: Leo closes the week at home with family, reflecting on why building this in public, crashes and all, is the whole point.
